title: OpenAI packages agent workflows for teachers and college students
friendlyTitle: OpenAI adds ready-made AI help for teaching and study
summary: OpenAI introduced three education plugins for K–12 teachers, college educators, and college students inside ChatGPT Edu and district deployments of ChatGPT for Teachers. They combine approved course materials, apps, skills, and common workflows for planning, study, research, and content creation.
friendlySummary: New plugins help teachers plan lessons and help college students study from their own course materials. Schools can control which tools and permissions are allowed.
whyItMatters: The useful shift is from asking isolated questions to giving learners and educators repeatable, institution-managed workflows. Schools retain control over enabled tools and permissions, while users get a clearer starting point than building complex prompts from scratch.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Teachers and students can spend less time setting up prompts and more time learning or preparing lessons. Human judgment still stays in charge.
